text: Trametinib is a highly selective, allosteric inhibitor of MEK1 (MAP2K1) and MEK2. In melanoma, this mechanism effectively blocks the hyperactive MAPK/ERK signaling pathway, which is frequently driven by *BRAF* mutations, thereby inhibiting tumor cell proliferation and survival.
